correctness.rationale: The Carleson packing condition bounds all prefix sums of ancestor masses; finiteness of bounded-measure ancestor intervals justifies their sequential ordering. The coordinatewise least feasible recurrence is proved by induction, explicitly solved for every real \(\Lambda>1\), with the endpoint \(\Lambda=1\) treated separately. Finite nested atomic families satisfy packing for every measurable subset and have exact packing constant \(\Lambda\), establishing universal sharpness. The standalone rational verifier executed successfully for 35 values and checked all subsets of its finite witnesses. Finite tests are not the proof of the arbitrary-parameter assertion.

A broad strong weighted theorem without a matching explicit sharp constant does not dominate the claim.
